page.layout: One page of verse, one column, centred in the text block. Running head at top centre with the page number at top left. Show-through from the facing page in the right margin, not transcribed. Catchword "Hac" at the lower right, outside the text block.

main_text.p: Qui cuncta rubri fulminis ignibus Terret caducis, quum ferit arduus Titanas Ætneos, minasq; Centimanas cohibet Gigantum:

Te perduelli cum grege turpium Perdet virorum, Barbare, Gallicæ Fatale monstrum Gentis, atque Innocuo rutilans cruore Immanis, eheu! bellua, quæ bonos Summi sequentes dogmata Numinis Virgis cruentas, igne torres, Et cruciibus lacerasq; ferro.

Verum reteEtis [?] Guisiadum dolis, Quæ nunc Nauarrum Gallia principem Virtute sublimi decorum Marte ferox petit impotente, Tandem secundo Numine sospitem, Pacata, iustis reddet honoribus, Et proximis regi benigna Sedibus egregium reponet.
Quem nunc cruentis fraudibus explicat, Et præp̄ [?] aratis mortibus eximit, Cunctisq; seruatum periclis Incolumem fouet aduocata Christi potentis dextera vindicis.
Hæ sola vires subruit impias. Hæc tela coniurata rumpit Sacrilegæ potior caterua,

page.notes: Show-through from the facing page on the right margin ignored. The word "reteEtis" is read as "retectis" with doubt; "cruciibus" and "præp̄" are uncertain readings; the line "Et præp̄ aratis" is partly abbreviated and may be illegible. The Æ in "Ætneos" and the q; abbreviations are kept as printed. The verse lines are joined within each stanza; the stanza breaks follow the indentation.
